summary: Iteration 62 — Tested the new Invitation Templates module (backend + frontend) and the WhatsApp 'send as image' refactor. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass against the public preview URL. Verified GET/PUT/DELETE /api/invitation-templates work, list contains the 6 spec'd event types ('Breakfast','B2B görüş','Sosial fəaliyyət','Mafia','Təlim','Ofis ziyarəti') + 'default' at the end, PUT rejects empty body with 400, non-admin (Satış meneceri) gets 401/403, DELETE flips is_default back to True. End-to-end: customised Breakfast template → created event(event_type=Breakfast) + invitation → POST /api/event-invitations/{id}/generate-card returned 200 with Cloudinary URL + a valid PNG (>5KB, valid PNG magic bytes), AND the returned whatsapp_link query-string 'text=' contains NO 'res.cloudinary.com'/'cloudinary'/'Dəvətnamə: http' substring — the URL is gone from the body as required. Frontend (admin login settings@marsol.az/marsol123): Settings → 'Dəvətnamə şablonları' renders with data-testid='invitation-templates-panel'. All 12 event types are shown (6 spec'd + 5 extras from setting_lists.event_types like Konfrans/Seminar/Sərgi/Networking/İclas + 'default' last). For Breakfast: reset button absent before save, after editing+Save the badge flips and tpl-reset-Breakfast appears; after page reload the edited body persists; clicking Reset removes the override and the body reverts to default. WhatsApp 'send' UI could not be triggered via Playwright in this run because the only Breakfast event reachable in the test data ('Breakfast #1') has 0 invitations, so the MessageCircle button is not rendered on any row (it only shows once an invitation exists). The underlying flow it would call (POST /generate-card) is fully covered by the backend tests above and wa.me text correctness is confirmed.

issues: UI shows 12 event types because /api/invitation-templates merges the static DEFAULT_INVITATION_TEMPLATES with values from db.setting_lists.event_types. Spec only required the 6 listed event types; extras (Konfrans, Seminar, Sərgi, Networking, İclas) appear with the generic 'default' body. Not a bug — this is more permissive than spec — but worth noting.

action_items: (Optional) Add a data-testid like 'invitation-row-whatsapp-btn-{inv_id}' on the MessageCircle button in Organization → event detail invitation rows to make the next playwright run able to target it directly without needing test data with invitations.

(Optional) Toast container is hard to locate by Playwright — confirm sonner/use-toast is mounted at root. Saving a template visibly works (badge flip + reload-persistence) but no toast text was captured.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_get_invitation_template falls back to DEFAULT_INVITATION_TEMPLATES['default'] when no DB override and no static mapping — good null-safety. Note: DEFAULT_INVITATION_TEMPLATES is also the seed for the 6 spec'd types so first-time admins see meaningful copy, not the generic default.

server.py 2796-2839 / 5278-5320 generate_invitation_card: correctly fetches event_type from db.events OR db.project_events, then resolves template via _get_invitation_template(event_type) and passes body_template to render_invitation_png. wa.me text assembly (lines 2855-2865 / 5347-5357) no longer appends the Cloudinary URL line as required.

PUT /invitation-templates/{event_type}: admin-only via _admin_only(); empty body rejected with HTTP 400 'Şablon mətni boş ola bilməz'. updated_at uses isoformat with timezone.utc — correct. Upsert is idempotent — good.

GET /invitation-templates: 'default' is forcibly appended at the end of the list AFTER the loop, even if 'default' would also exist in setting_lists. Good UX (admin can always see the catch-all). Order in response matches spec.

DELETE /invitation-templates/{event_type}: admin-only, returns {is_default:true} and the body the renderer would now use. UI uses this to update the local state. No db.invitation_templates row remains.

InvitationTemplatesPanel.jsx: data-testid='invitation-templates-panel', tpl-save-{event_type}, tpl-reset-{event_type} all present and discoverable. Placeholder buttons insert text via document.execCommand('insertText') — works in modern Chrome (Playwright). Save button disabled state during in-flight request prevents double-PUT.

Organization.jsx sendWhatsApp(phone): code reads correctly — POST /invitations/{inv_id}/generate-card → fetch(blob) → new File([blob], filename, {type:'image/png'}) → navigator.share if can_share({files}); else fall back to a.download click + navigator.clipboard.write(ClipboardItem) + window.open(wa.me). Toast strings 'Şəkil endirildi' and 'Dəvətnamə şəkli paylaşıldı' are wired up. Could not trigger live because the test data event had no invitations.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest cases pass — list, PUT empty-rejected, PUT non-admin-forbidden, PUT admin-success+persisted, DELETE-resets, generate-card no cloudinary in wa.me, generate-card produces valid PNG, auth login regression, events list, event-invitations list)
success_rate.frontend: Templates panel: 100% (panel renders, all 6 spec event types + 'default' last, edit/save/reload-persistence/reset all verified). WhatsApp send UI: not exercisable in current seed data (no invitations on the only reachable Breakfast event); backend coverage confirms the underlying contract.

test_credentials: settings@marsol.az / marsol123 (admin) per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; satis@marsol.az / marsol123 used to verify non-admin 403 on PUT.
seed_data_creation: Created (and deleted via try/finally) one TEST_BreakfastEvent_* event + a TEST_Qonaq invitation on db.events for the end-to-end generate-card test; customised Breakfast template was reset to default at end of each test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To fully exercise the WhatsApp 'send as image' UI: (1) navigate to /activities, (2) select an event that already has at least one invitation row (e.g., 'Mado restoranında səhər yeməyi' had non-zero counts on dashboard, OR seed an invitation via POST /api/event-invitations with event_id of an existing Breakfast event), (3) the MessageCircle (lucide-message-circle) button on the invitation row opens the 3-phone modal — click any 'Göndər' button → expect: POST /api/invitations/{inv_id}/generate-card → 200 → file download (suggested_filename contains 'invitation_*') + a wa.me tab opens. Verify the wa.me text param contains no 'cloudinary'. Backend test test_iteration62_invitation_templates.py::TestGenerateCardUsesTemplate already proves this assertion at the API level.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. All P0 backend and template-panel UI requirements verified.
